# QCAD MCP

> AI-driven 2D CAD automation — DXF/DWG parsing, SVG preview, STL extrusion, room analysis, DXF creation, persistent file depot with full CRUD. FastMCP 3.4 server on port 11966.

## Tools (v0.5.0 portmanteau surface — 8 tools + 4 cards)

- `plan(op=...)` — Core ezdxf ops: info, to_svg, extrude, stack, obj, glb, drawings, export, analyse, create, depot
- `plan_edit(op=...)` — convert (DWG<->DXF), modify (layers/entities)
- `plan_annotate(op=...)` — dimension, measure, text, hatch, block_insert, array, wall_data, beam_analysis
- `plan_pro(op=...)` — QCAD Pro: script, render, exec
- `plan_library(op=...)` — blocks, blocks_download, scripts_search, scripts_download
- `plan_ai(op=...)` — generate, agentic, transpile, sampling
- `plan_bim(op=...)` — auto_dimension, building_meta, to_ifc_data
- `qcad(op=...)` — status, help, shutdown
- `show_*_card` — Prefab display cards (status, depot, beam, building meta)

## Prompts
- `cad_expert` — Get CAD expertise and tool guidance
- `cad_analyse_plan` — Analyse a DXF floor plan step by step
- `cad_extrude_3d` — Extrude a DXF floor plan to 3D STL mesh

## Resources
- `cad://depot` — List all files in the persistent CAD depot
- `cad://depot/{filename}` — Get info about a specific depot file

## Architecture
- Core: ezdxf 1.4 (pure Python, no binary deps)
- Optional: QCAD Pro for ECMAScript bridge, native rendering, DWG
- Persistent depot: %LOCALAPPDATA%\qcad-mcp\depot
- REST API: http://localhost:11966/api/v1/
- Webapp: http://localhost:11967
